description: Every individual fact on file for one product, grouped by topic: water and durability, temperature, battery and charging, display, camera, audio, connectivity, health sensors, lenses and sun, size and weight, chip and software. Each carries its value, unit, who stated it (Confirmed is the maker's own statement) and the source page. Optional topic narrows the list, e.g. 'temperature' or 'battery'.
name: get_detailed_facts
title: Detailed facts for a product
